transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

I guess… I’ve just been worrying about everything all the time. Work stuff, mostly—like whether this new lab partnership means my position could get cut, or if my data’s wrong. Then it turns into bills, my family thinking I’m behind, grad school… like I’ve already messed up my chances. It’s hard to get my mind to stop jumping around.
Do these worries happen mostly in social situations, like when you're around other people or giving presentations, or do they occur more generally, even when you're alone?

It’s more general. It’s not just presentations or being around people. Even when I’m by myself, my mind jumps from the lab partnership maybe affecting my job, to my data being wrong, to bills, my family… grad school. It just kind of keeps going.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms like restlessness, trouble sleeping, muscle tension, or irritability along with these worries?

Yeah… mostly I feel really wound up. At work I can’t really settle in my chair, so I’ll tap my foot or keep checking messages. Sometimes I end up walking back to the instrument room even when I don’t really need to. Normal lab noises make me jump more than they should.

How long have you been feeling this way? Have these worries and physical symptoms been going on for at least six months, or did they start more recently in response to a specific stressor like the lab partnership change?
About seven months, I think. It started around when the lab funding shifted and that commercial partnership changed how things were being run. It’s kind of just… stayed since then.
Have you also been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or do you mostly just feel anxious and restless?
I’m not sure… I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest exactly. Mostly it’s the anxious, restless feeling. Mood-wise, I don’t really know how to separate it.
Have you had days where you feel down or hopeless nearly every day, even when things aren’t stressful at work?

I don’t think it’s nearly every day. I mean… I have bad days, but it’s hard to tell if that’s “down” or just worn out from being on edge. When work isn’t in my face, I’m not usually sitting there feeling hopeless or anything.
Would you say you feel excessive anxiety and worry more days than not, even when there isn’t an immediate stressor like a work issue happening?

Yeah… more days than not. It’s not just when something happens at work. My mind keeps jumping around—like whether the lab partnership means my position gets cut, or if my data’s wrong, or bills, or my family thinking I’m falling behind… grad school stuff too. It’s kind of constant.
